sources.title: Apollo.io pricing (features/FAQ content only; plan price amounts not rendered in fetched content)
Third-party summary of Apollo.io 2026 plan prices, used to fill amounts not visible on the official page in this session

freePlan.limits: Free plan for 1 user with access to the 240M contact / 30M company database; email sending limited to Gmail only; capped credits.

keyLimits.en: 1 user, Gmail-only sending, limited credits, database access.
Email sequencing with A/B testing, higher credit allowance than Free.
Call recording, sales pipeline management (Opportunities), higher credit allowance.
3-seat minimum, API access, highest credit allowance.

cautions.en: Export credits are consumed separately when syncing contact data outside Apollo, on top of the per-seat subscription.

Plan price amounts (Basic/Professional/Organization) could not be read directly from the official pricing page's rendered content in this session; figures were cross-checked against a third-party pricing summary and should be re-verified against apollo.io/pricing.

capabilities.en: B2B contact and company database with 240M contacts and 30M companies for lead sourcing.
Email sequencing with A/B testing for outbound sales outreach.
Call recording and sales pipeline (Opportunities) management on paid plans.

limitations.en: Free and lower-tier plans restrict email sending to Gmail only; Microsoft 365 and other providers require a paid plan.
Bulk lead selection is capped by a record selection limit, restricting large list-building actions.

reason.en: Already listed as a current alternative; overlaps on sales pipeline and outreach tooling.

Already listed as a current alternative; competing multi-channel outbound prospecting tool.
Direct competitor in B2B contact database and sales intelligence.
